en: The image shows the back side of a mailed postcard. There is a Polish postage stamp depicting a tank and the word "POLSKA," with circular postmarks that read "WARSZAWA." The left margin credits the photographer and mentions Warszawa. The right side has blue handwritten address text to Estonia, USSR. The lower half is filled with blue handwritten message text dated "Warszaw, 18.7.68." The layout is the standard divided back of a mid‑20th‑century postcard.
